articles.name: The second test is live: 70 new skills, 116 new maps, Ossyria on August 8
articles.keywords: second-cot-test-is-live The second test opened with all ten 3rd job branches and 70 new skills. We counted 116 new maps, 98 new monsters, and 148 new quests. Ossyria opens during the test on August 8. The test reaches level 70, where 3rd job starts. No 4th job is included. The Ossyria area covers Orbis, El Nath, Orbis Tower, and the ice fields. Zakum is absent even though The Door to Zakum map exists. Crimson Balrog is the new boss at level 100 with about 741,000 HP. Citizenship starts at level 12. Players choose Henesys or Kerning City and advance through ten grades with daily and weekly quests. The build adds 102 hair and face styles plus nine eye colors. Power Guard and Hyper Body moved to 3rd job. Rush took their 2nd job slots; Mage attacks hit harder, and Archer Final Attack triggers more often. Five events run during the test. Characters are wiped when it ends. Ludibrium ticket and toy-item records exist without playable Ludibrium maps. The Citizenship towns also have estate agents and furnishing shops without housing. Nexon had announced neither feature, so we list them as unplayable findings. cot patch NiaMeowDB
